text: No, the property was not entirely cleared in 2021. Only about 2.23% of the asset (81.3 hectares) experienced tree-cover loss that year. The loss primarily affected planted forests (68.1 hectares of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with minimal impact on native forests (0 hectares). Additionally, 37.3 hectares of small patches (<0.5 ha) were cleared but not counted as part of the main event. The majority of the property remained unaffected.
